@phoneRecvHelpTitle.description: Title of the short help sheet on the Receive screen.

phoneRecvHelp1: Share this wallet’s address or code. Anyone with it can pay this wallet.
phoneRecvHelp2: Ask for an amount makes a code that asks for a set amount.
phoneRecvHelp3: Other ways to receive are for when the payer cannot use this wallet’s address.

@phoneRecvListening.description: Status line on Receive while the wallet is connected and waiting for payments.

@phoneRecvAsk.description: Row on Receive and title of the screen that asks the payer for a set amount.

phoneRecvAskLine: The payer sees the amount and what it is for

@phoneRecvAskLine.description: Line under the Ask for an amount row.

phoneRecvAskLineLink: Makes a link that asks for it

@phoneRecvAskLineLink.description: Line under the Ask for an amount row when the wallet receives through epic1 links.

@phoneRecvOther.description: Row on Receive and title of the sheet with the other ways to get paid.

phoneRecvOtherLine: In person, or with a file

@phoneRecvOtherLine.description: Line under the Other ways to receive row.

phoneRecvOtherSheetLine: For when the payer cannot use this wallet’s address.

@phoneRecvOtherSheetLine.description: Line under the title of the Other ways to receive sheet.

phoneRecvInPersonLine: Scan the payer’s code, then show a reply code

@phoneRecvInPersonLine.description: Line under In person in the Other ways to receive sheet.

phoneRecvFileLine: Open a payment file, or paste its text

@phoneRecvFileLine.description: Line under With a file in the Other ways to receive sheet.

phoneRecvTorLine: Straight to this phone, over Tor

@phoneRecvTorLine.description: Line under Tor address in the Other ways to receive sheet.

@phoneRecvOff.description: Value on the Tor address row when receiving over Tor is off. One word.

@phoneRecvFromAnyone.description: Chip on the Ask for an amount screen: the request is for whoever opens it.

@phoneRecvFromName.description: Chip on the Ask for an amount screen: the request goes to one contact. {name} is the contact.

@phoneRecvWho.description: Title of the sheet that picks who the request is for.

@phoneRecvAnyoneCode.description: Choice in the who-pays sheet: a code anyone can scan.

phoneRecvAnyoneCodeLine: The payer scans a code on this screen

@phoneRecvAnyoneCodeLine.description: Line under the Anyone, with a code choice.

@phoneRecvAnyoneFile.description: Choice in the who-pays sheet: a file anyone can open.

phoneRecvAnyoneFileLine: Saves a file you hand over

@phoneRecvAnyoneFileLine.description: Line under the Anyone, with a file choice.

@phoneRecvAnyoneAddress.description: Choice in the who-pays sheet: a code with the wallet's own Epicbox address and the amount; the payer sends as usual with the amount filled in.

phoneRecvAnyoneAddressLine: A code with your address and the amount

@phoneRecvAnyoneAddressLine.description: Line under the Anyone, with my address choice.

phoneRecvLinkLead: Show this code or share the link. Whoever scans or pastes it gets a normal send to your address with {amount} filled in.

@phoneRecvLinkLead.description: Lead on the screen that shows the wallet's address with an amount as a code. {amount} is the amount with its unit.

@phoneRecvLinkCopied.description: Notice after the payment link (address with an amount) was copied.

phoneRecvLinkQrLabel: Your address with the amount, as a QR code

@phoneRecvLinkQrLabel.description: What a screen reader says for the code that holds the wallet's address and an amount.

@phoneRecvAskFor.description: Button that sends the request. {amount} is the amount with its unit.

phoneRecvCodeLead: Show this code or share it. Whoever opens it is asked for {amount}.

@phoneRecvCodeLead.description: Lead on the screen that shows a request as a code. {amount} is the amount with its unit.

@phoneRecvWaitingPaid.description: Status line under a request code that nobody has paid yet.

@phoneRecvViewPayment.description: Button on the sheet for an arriving payment: opens the payment page.

@phoneRecvArrivalFrom.description: Line under the amount on the sheet for an arriving payment. {name} is the sender.
